_help: One project. Photos are original file names inside this event's export folder; run scripts/prepare_media.py after changing them. layout: wide | pair (two in a row) | detail. focus = CSS object-position for crops. location: one {en, he} or a list of them, main venue first. palette: 4 colours (#RRGGBB, top to bottom) + one photo; palette_source: designer | extracted.

text.en: A family from Manhattan came to Jerusalem to celebrate Aaron's bar mitzvah around Sukkot. The celebration moved between two settings: a Shabbat celebration with Aaron's aliyah to the Torah in a sukkah at Terasa, facing the walls of Jerusalem, and an evening party at Olmaya.
text.he: משפחה ממנהטן הגיעה לירושלים לחגוג את בר המצווה של אהרן סביב חג הסוכות. החגיגה עברה בין שני מקומות: חגיגת שבת ועלייה לתורה בסוכה בטרסה, מול חומות ירושלים, ומסיבת ערב בעולמיה.

cover.why: Long tables under fringed lampshades and a sukkah roof, with the view behind: the strongest design photo, warm terracotta tones unlike any other cover.

hero.why: Wide establishing frame from the approved shortlist.

palette.why: Extracted from the chapter photos; paired with the orange orchids (approved).
